set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/child-process-reaping
before_lines=$(wc -l < results.tsv)
/usr/bin/python ./supervisor.py 6 &
parent_pid=$!
sleep 0.03
kill -0 "$parent_pid"
child_pids=$(pgrep -P "$parent_pid" | tr '\n' ' ')
printf 'running_parent=%s child_pids=%s\n' "$parent_pid" "$child_pids"
ps -o pid,ppid,state,stat,args -p "$parent_pid" $(pgrep -P "$parent_pid" | sed 's/^/-p /')
wait "$parent_pid"
supervisor_rc=$?
after_lines=$(wc -l < results.tsv)
printf 'supervisor_rc=%s before_lines=%s after_lines=%s appended=%s\n' "$supervisor_rc" "$before_lines" "$after_lines" "$((after_lines-before_lines))"
printf '%s\n' '--- preserved prefix and complete results ---'
cat results.tsv
printf '%s\n' '--- post-completion PID check ---'
if [ -d "/proc/$parent_pid" ]; then printf 'parent still exists\n'; exit 1; else printf 'parent reaped by shell\n'; fi
for pid in $child_pids; do
  if [ -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then printf 'child PID %s still exists\n' "$pid"; exit 1; fi
done
printf 'all child PIDs gone\n'
run_id=$(tail -n 1 results.tsv | cut -d, -f1)
awk -F, -v run="$run_id" '
  $1 == run { count++; seen[$2]++; if (($2 % 2 == 0 && $3 != 0) || ($2 % 2 == 1 && $3 != 3)) bad=1 }
  END {
    for (i=0; i<6; i++) if (seen[i] != 1) bad=1;
    printf "validated_run=%s rows=%d parity_statuses=%s\n", run, count, bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS";
    exit bad || count != 6
  }
' results.tsv
first_two=$(sed -n '1p;2p' results.tsv)
expected=$(printf 'run,job,exit_status\nprevious,0,0')
[ "$first_two" = "$expected" ]
printf 'previous_results_preserved=PASS\n'
